subject: [hw] D01 -> V40: the three register windows of the VCU node (exact bases/lengths)
body:
From mt6893.dts:6212-6218, the vcu@16000000 node (compatible mediatek-vcu, vcuid 0, mailbox-gce) declares exactly three register windows:
  0x16000000 + 0x40000  VDEC_BASE
  0x17020000 + 0x10000  VENC_BASE
  0x17820000 + 0x10000  VENC_C1_BASE
VCU_MAP_HW_REG_NUM is 4 (mtk_vcu.c:133), so one slot is unused. This matches the literal mmap we found in the daemon (vdec_drv_init_hw_info: mmap(NULL, 0x40000, RW, SHARED, fd, 0x16000000)) and vcu_check_reg_base() (mtk_vcu.c:679): accept an mmap offset inside one of those three ranges, reject anything else below 0x40000000. Added to FACTS.md rows 1.24-1.26. Test still N2TEST D01 PASS 32/32.
